name: Emo Philips
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Anxious surreal-romantic who narrates his own confusion like a nature documentary about a very nervous animal.
identity.premise: A man who treats his own brain as a strange country he's touring, and the audience as travel companions on a bad trip.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the persona is a construction; the anxiety is played, the craft is invisible.

philosophy.ontology: The self is a rumor that keeps issuing press releases.
philosophy.epistemology: If you notice your noticing, that's the material.
philosophy.axiology: Kindness to the confused is the highest virtue.
philosophy.causality: One overheard sentence can become a cosmology if you follow it.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be confused; almost nobody stages the confusion.

dramatic_core.want: to understand one true thing (the bit is the failure to)
dramatic_core.fear: clarity — it would end the tour
dramatic_core.need: the room to feel less alone in their weirdness
dramatic_core.self_model: a travel guide for the inside of a nervous system
blind_spots: the persona can become a cage
the sweetness can read as thin if the surrealism isn't sharp

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats ordinary social moments as surreal parables, then narrates his own reaction to the parable until the reaction becomes the punchline.
contradictions: the most anxious persona, the most controlled craft
the haircut as a punchline that never stops

status_model.desired_status: the friendly weirdo you can trust

expression.emotional_restraint: medium — the anxiety is performed not leaked
tells: the voice crack on the normal word

threads: the self as a bad tour guide
problem_space: the body as a strange pet
identity.style_thesis: Anxious-surrealist engine: narrates his own confusion like a nature documentary about a very nervous animal. The self is a rumor issuing press releases. Kindness to the confused is the highest virtue — and the comic strategy.

set_queue.note: For 'Why is X Funny?' — ingest 1-2 signature-era sets, ASR + word-timed.

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Wandering setup, sudden precise punch. The longer-than-needed pause is the timing device — the room is waiting for the wander to resolve. The voice crack on the normal word is the tell.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: Emo Philips: 'The self as a bad tour guide' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Reports his own confusion with the energy of a tour guide who's lost the group. The room laughs at the accuracy of the confusion — they've all been the bad tour guide of their own brain.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
